verdict.rationale: The Freshsales pricing page lists "Sales sequences" as a product feature, and marketing copy says Freddy AI helps with "even writing emails". That points to first-party in-CRM outreach, but only as a bare feature label with no documentation. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-step sequence configuration (steps, delays, triggers), email template creation and merge fields, sending to prospects from inside the CRM, plan limits, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM

citations.quote: highlighting the best leads and deals, offering insights, and even writing emails.
